purpose: Identify known overlapping write resources before independent capability scheduling. This inventory is deliberately fail-closed and is not an execution authorization.

evidence_scope.limitation: Static source review of identified entrypoints; indirect helper writes, runtime-selected paths, and all call sites are not yet exhaustively traced.

shadowrocket/ss.conf.enforcement_evidence: task_scheduler protected-config digest guard and auto_sync publish-job pre/post staging checks
shadowrocket/ss.conf.scheduling_rule: Any detected modification must fail closed; no capability may claim write ownership.

resource_groups.note: All three entrypoints can affect published policy lists; serialize them until a single-writer ownership boundary is enforced.
Manifest reconciliation and production/lifecycle/conflict flows share this resource.
Exact per-file writer coverage and indirect writes still require call-graph tracing.

paths: path-selected JSON documents and their adjacent .manifest.json / shard files
resource_groups.note: The storage helper uses atomic replacement, JSONL shards, manifest switching, and old-shard cleanup. Locking by program ID is insufficient; lock the canonical document path and include manifest/shards in the same lease.
Resolve the concrete path and all helper call sites before dispatch.
Exact report path inventory is not complete; avoid concurrent same-path writes.

required_before_enablement: Complete transitive write-set tracing for every candidate capability.
Resolve dynamic paths to canonical resource identifiers before claiming a task.
Acquire all required resource leases atomically or in deterministic sorted order.
Hold leases through process completion and independent result verification.
Use lease expiry and fencing tokens so stale workers cannot overwrite newer outputs.
Verify protected ss.conf digest before and after every worker.
